tools.name: think
tools.description: Pause and reason about a situation. No side effects, no data changes — just structured thinking. Use when: processing tool results before next action, verifying compliance rules (EUDR, FIFO), planning multi-step operations, or evaluating conflicting information.

thought.description: Your reasoning, analysis, or plan. Write out your thinking step by step.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products in a tenant catalog. Returns safe columns only (no cost_price/markup). Filter by type, category, name, or in_stock status.

slug.description: Tenant slug of a live tenant (e.g. thespot)

type.description: Product type filter (e.g., granulas, briketes, saplaksnis)

response_format.description: Response detail level: "concise" (default, key fields only) or "detailed" (all fields)

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Get current product prices with calculated price_per_kg. Returns EUR pricing for all in-stock products.

slug.description: Tenant slug of a live tenant (e.g. thespot)

product_slug.description: Specific product slug (optional — omit for all)

response_format.description: Response detail level: "concise" (default, key fields only) or "detailed" (all fields)

tools.name: query_trade
tools.description: Sputnik X EU trade intelligence — query 67.7M Eurostat COMEXT rows in the 2026-08-27 snapshot; EU27 reporters; monthly 2005-01–2026-06; HS2 only (97 distinct codes overall, but only 80 chapters in 2005–2021); historical chapter gaps verified 2026-10-23; consult current data_quality for recent periods. Query types: overview, countries, timeline, top_partners, top_products, balance, heatmap, macro_context (current global ECB/FRED snapshot). Supported filters depend on the REST view. EU-wide CN8 must not be inferred; see https://sputnikx.xyz/.well-known/data-coverage.json.

response_format.description: Response detail level: "concise" (default, key fields only) or "detailed" (all fields)

tools.name: daloopa_query
tools.description: Daloopa fundamentals lookup for commodity-exposed equities (read-only). Returns per-ticker structured fundamentals (revenue, opex, segment splits) sourced from issuer filings. Configure DALOOPA_API_URL + DALOOPA_API_KEY in .env; otherwise pass test_mode=true to receive deterministic mock fixtures suitable for CI and demos. No mutation — fail-open with mock if upstream is unreachable.

ticker.description: Equity ticker symbol (e.g. "CLF", "X", "FCX"). 1..16 chars, uppercase recommended.

metric.description: Optional metric filter (e.g. "revenue", "segment_revenue", "opex"). Omit to return all available metrics.

periods.description: How many fiscal periods to return (default 4, max 20).

test_mode.description: When true, return deterministic mock fixtures and skip the external API call entirely.

tools.name: mt_newswires_query
tools.description: MT Newswires commodity headlines (read-only). Pulls the configured RSS or JSON feed (MT_NEWSWIRES_RSS_URL / MT_NEWSWIRES_API_URL), parses up to `limit` items, and returns {title, pubDate, link, summary, source}. Use as a low-latency news ticker for commodity-trader agents. Pass test_mode=true for deterministic mock fixtures; the tool auto-falls back to mocks if the feed is unreachable.

topic.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter applied to title+summary (e.g. "oil", "copper", "wheat"). Omit for unfiltered feed.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 cutoff (e.g. "2026-05-16T00:00:00Z"). Only items with pubDate >= since are returned.

test_mode.description: When true, return deterministic mock fixtures and skip the external feed entirely.
